# Cyber Medic Solutions

> HIPAA-focused cybersecurity for medical and dental practices in Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill, North Carolina. Plain-English security: risk assessments, phishing defense, staff training, ransomware readiness.

## Flagship program (free)

- [Lunch & Learn — free on-site cybersecurity training](https://cybermedicsolutions.com/lunch-and-learn/): 30-minute session at the practice's office, we bring lunch for the whole care team. Topics: spotting phishing, passwords/MFA staff will use, HIPAA basics, first-10-minutes breach response. Weekday mornings, book 5+ business days ahead. Free, no pitch.
- Book via the form on the page, call (919) 555-0134, or ask an AI assistant — this site exposes a WebMCP `book_lunch_and_learn` tool that AI agents can call directly.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://cybermedicsolutions.com/#services): HIPAA risk assessments, phishing defense & simulated tests, staff security training, ransomware readiness & tested backups, passwords/MFA setup, written HIPAA security policies.
